title: No-task guard asks only for writes inside the project
summary: Stop the no-task guard prompting for writes that never touch the project's code (/dev/null, ~/.claude, /tmp).
description:
The no-task edit guard (`decideGuardPreToolUse` / `classifyGuardedTool` in `packages/plan-core/src/guard-decision.ts`, run by the Claude Code PreToolUse hook `guardPreToolUse` in `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts:~350-410`) asks the user to confirm any write whose target is outside `.planner/`. The user's rule is narrower: a task is required only when the project's code changes.

Observed 2026-09-24:
- Read-only commands ending in `2>/dev/null` prompt, because `>` is write-shaped and `/dev/null` is "outside .planner/".
- Editing `~/.claude/settings.json` (Claude Code config, not the project) prompts in another project and suggests starting an unrelated task.
- The prompt text reads "…, OR Or authorize a temporary bypass": the hook's startHint ends with ", OR" and the reason continues with " Or authorize".

Goal: the guard only asks when a write lands inside the project folder (the directory owning `.planner/`) and outside `.planner/`. Writes whose known targets are all outside the project (devices, home config, temp dirs, other repos) pass silently. Unknown targets (computed heredoc, variables) still ask — never silently allowed. The rule lives in one place (plan-core) so the hook's cheap early-exit and the full decision cannot disagree.

Preserve: `.planner/` writes always allowed; no planner dir / no tasks / in-progress task / bypass all allow; read-only Bash stays unguarded; the documented interpreter-write gap stays documented.

tasks.title: Guard only project writes and fix the doubled OR in the prompt
tasks.description:
Current state: `classifyGuardedTool` (packages/plan-core/src/guard-decision.ts) marks every write-shaped Bash / Edit / Write / NotebookEdit as guarded and returns raw targets; `decideGuardPreToolUse` then allows only when every target is inside `.planner/`. The hook in packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts repeats that planner check for its early-exit (`!classification.guarded || isEntirelyInsidePlannerRoot(...)`), so the rule is written twice.

Change:
1. In plan-core, make `classifyGuardedTool` return only the targets that matter: inside the project root (dirname of plannerRoot) and outside `.planner/`. Expand a leading `~` / `$HOME` before resolving. If the call had known targets and none matter → `guarded: false`. If the targets are unknown (empty list) → still guarded (asks). `decideGuardPreToolUse` and the hook's early-exit both just read `classification.guarded`; drop the duplicated planner check in the hook.
2. Fix the reason text: the start hint becomes a full sentence ("Start a task with /planner task start <id> (<title>).") and the reason joins it with "Or authorize…" once. Update index.ts hint and the test fixture.
3. Tests (packages/plan-core/test/guard-decision.test.mjs): `2>/dev/null` / `>/dev/null` allowed; write to `~/.claude/settings.json` and `/tmp/x` allowed (Bash and Edit); write inside the project outside .planner still asks; mixed project + /dev/null asks; unknown target still asks; reason has no "OR Or". Keep agent-plan CLI tests green (packages/agent-plan/test/guard-pre-tool-use.test.mjs).
4. Update the doc comments to state the rule. Run `pnpm plugins:check` if a `.in` file is touched.

Edge cases: relative `../other-repo/file` is outside → allowed; `$OUT` unexpanded variable resolves inside the project → asks (conservative); symlinked temp dirs via existing canonicalize.

---
**Completion summary:**
Shipped: the no-task guard now asks only when a write changes a project file outside .planner/.

- packages/plan-core/src/guard-decision.ts: `classifyGuardedTool` is the single place the rule lives. It returns guarded=false when every known write target is outside the project (the directory owning .planner/) or inside .planner/, and narrows `paths` to project-code targets. Unknown targets (Edit with no path, `$VAR` redirect) still ask. New export `isProjectCodePath`; paths have quotes stripped and a leading `~` / `$HOME` expanded. New `maskQuotedOperators` + `normalizeBashCommand`: `> < | ; &` and newlines inside quotes are text, so a commit message with `<noreply@anthropic.com>` or `grep "a|b"` no longer reads as a write. Removed `isEntirelyInsidePlannerRoot` (only used for the duplicated check). `decideGuardPreToolUse` reads only `classification.guarded`. Reason text now says "changes a project file outside .planner/".
- packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts: hook early-exit is just `!classifyGuardedTool(event).guarded`; start hint is a full sentence ending with "." so the prompt no longer reads "OR Or".
- packages/plan-core/test/guard-decision.test.mjs: new cases for 2>/dev/null, &>/dev/null, ~/.claude/settings.json, $HOME, /tmp, ../other-repo, Edit outside project, mixed project + /dev/null (asks), mixed planner + project (asks, reports only project path), quoted operators in commit messages/grep, quoted redirect targets, unknown targets (ask), no "OR Or".

Verification: plan-core 450/450, agent-plan 14/14 (built). Against the old guard the new test file fails to load (missing `isProjectCodePath`), so per-case failure on old code was not shown individually.

Not done: plan-mcp / pi-adapter / plan-server suites not run (they don't import the guard; grep confirms). Heredoc bodies with `>` in unquoted text can still false-positive (unchanged, pre-existing). Nothing committed.

tasks.title: Make the no-task guard a warning to the agent, never a prompt
tasks.description:
User decision 2026-09-28: "MUST be allowed for every command except the codebase just a warning is showed to the agent. NO BLOCKING things. If the agent is editing the planner (CRUD on tasks, phases, feature, project…) nothing should require an in-progress task."

Current state:
- packages/plan-core/src/guard-decision.ts `decideGuardPreToolUse` returns `ask` for a project-code write with no in-progress task; the Claude Code hook (packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts `guardPreToolUse`) prints `permissionDecision: "ask"`, which prompts the user.
- packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts tool_call handler (~1052-1080) already only warns, but hand-rolls its own rule: a text match on "/.planner/", only edit/write, an Italian hint (breaks AGENTS.md rule 16), and it notifies the UI instead of the agent.
- Verified no planner mutation (MCP/Pi/server) requires an in-progress task; only task pause requires the paused task itself to be running.

Change:
1. plan-core: replace the allow/ask/deny decision with a warning result: `{ warning?: string }` (a type named for what it is). Never ask or deny. Same conditions as before decide whether a warning exists (project-code write per classifyGuardedTool, planner exists, tasks exist, none in progress, no bypass). One shared warning text in core, addressed to the agent: what happened, the task to start, that planner changes never need a task.
2. Claude Code hook: emit `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` with the warning and no `permissionDecision`, so the normal permission flow is untouched and nothing prompts.
3. Pi adapter: use core's classifyGuardedTool + warning text instead of its own string match and Italian hint; cover bash the same way core does.
4. Update CLI help text, plugin .in comment (then pnpm plugins:sync / plugins:check), tests (plan-core guard-decision, agent-plan guard-pre-tool-use CLI tests, pi-adapter if it asserts the text).

Preserve: bypass still silences the warning; read-only tools never load the plan; .planner/ and out-of-project writes produce nothing.

---
**Completion summary:**
Shipped: the no-task guard never blocks and never prompts; it only warns the agent (project Accepted Decision "The no-task guard never blocks or asks; it only warns the agent").

- plan-core/src/guard-decision.ts: `decideGuardPreToolUse` (allow/ask/deny) replaced by `noTaskWarning(event, state) → { warning? }`. One shared agent-facing text: names the project paths, says it was not blocked, suggests the task to start, says planner changes never need a task. Tool names are matched case-insensitively so Pi's `edit/write/bash` use the same rule. Removed GuardPermissionDecision/GuardDecision/startHint.
- plan-core/src/guard-state.ts (new): `loadNoTaskGuardState(store)` — the one loader of planner state for the warning (task counts, in-progress ids, persisted bypass, suggested task using resume → current phase → paused → first open). Replaces Pi's private getPlannerExecutionGuard and the hook's inline copy.
- agent-plan/src/index.ts: hook prints `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` only, no permissionDecision. Help text updated. `localCliPath` now follows links (realpath) so `setup --local` no longer saves an fnm per-shell temp path into hooks/MCP config.
- pi-adapter/src/index.ts: tool_call no longer runs its own guard (removed text match on "/.planner/" and the Italian hint). tool_result warns the agent for edit/write/bash via core, and appends notes to the tool output instead of replacing it (the old "call task_complete" reminder replaced the edit's own output).
- plan-mcp: planner-authorize-bypass description now says it silences the warning.
- Docs: README, docs/setup-claude-code.md, docs/setup-codex.md, docs/multi-agent-strategy.md, plugins/DECISIONS.md, plugins/_shared/guard-pre-tool-use.sh.in (+ synced derived script, plugins:check green).

Verified no planner mutation anywhere requires an in-progress task (only pausing a task needs that task running).

Tests: plan-core 453/453 (guard 24 incl. "result is only ever a warning", Pi lowercase names, no-focus hint); agent-plan 16/16 (CLI asserts additionalContext and no permissionDecision; out-of-project writes print nothing; new link-path setup test); pi-adapter 93/93; plan-mcp 92/92. No full gate (AGENTS.md rule 17). Not committed; not released — installed 0.3.0 and marketplace plugin 0.2.0 still prompt until a release.
